Name: Meat Vat Farm Cave
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] to add an option to the farm cave event with Demetrius, allowing him to set it up to cultivate lab-grown meat.

Vats will produce 1-2 bug meat per day.

Sometimes they will fail, and only produce slime.

On very rare occasions they will fail spectacularly and create a slime egg instead.

You can also purchase meat vats from Robin for 10,000 each.

This mod requires the following mods to work:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10152]Custom Object Production[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
